title: Job Queue: resume interrupted finalization on task retry
summary: When a task is retried after the job already finished but its bookkeeping failed, the Job Queue Dispatcher now completes the pending log entry and runs FinalizeRun instead of exiting. The job is not re-run, and recurring entries no longer stop being scheduled.
key_points: Acts only when a locked re-read shows the entry is still Finished, Manual Recurrence is off, and a log entry for the same System Task ID is In Process or Success
Sets the pending log entry to Success and calls FinalizeRun, which schedules the next run or deletes a non-recurring entry
Activates the next waiting job in the same category
Emits new warning telemetry 0000WW6 (Job queue entry finalization resumed)
Tests cover rescheduling a recurring entry, deleting a non-recurring entry, and leaving entries untouched when there is no matching log or Manual Recurrence is on
quote: A recurring Job Queue Entry can stop being scheduled forever.
